user.title: Fronius Virtual Inverter
user.description: What would you like to add?

menu_options.meter: Virtual smart meter (for a real Fronius inverter)

inverter.title: Virtual inverter
inverter.description: The Wattpilot discovers this virtual inverter on your network and pairs with it for PV surplus (Eco) charging.

data_description.name: Also the mDNS hostname, e.g. fronius-virtual becomes fronius-virtual.local. Letters, digits and hyphens only. Cannot be changed later.
data_description.system_name: Shown in the Wattpilot pairing screen and used as the serial number, e.g. MyHome. Defaults to the hostname.
data_description.port: Port for the Fronius Solar API (default 80).

grid.title: Grid & solar
grid.description: The sensors the Wattpilot needs for PV surplus charging.

data_description.p_grid_sensor: Signed grid power: positive = importing, negative = exporting. Leave empty if you use separate import/export sensors below.
data_description.p_grid_invert: Enable if your sensor reports export as positive.
data_description.p_pv_invert: Enable if your sensor reports generation as negative.
data_description.grid_phases: Without per-phase sensors, grid power is split evenly across three phases, or all on phase 1 for single phase.
data_description.grid_ct_rating: Reported to the Wattpilot as the maximum current, so it never draws more than your supply allows.

grid_split.name: Separate import/export sensors
grid_split.description: Use these instead of the signed grid sensor if your meter reports import and export as two positive values.

data_description.p_grid_import_sensor: Power drawn from the grid (positive values).
data_description.p_grid_export_sensor: Power fed into the grid (positive values).

battery.title: Battery & house load (optional)
battery.description: Leave anything you don't have empty. Per-phase load balancing sensors and Smart Meter IP (Modbus) emulation can be added afterwards from Configure.

data_description.p_akku_sensor: Signed battery power in Fronius convention: positive = discharging, negative = charging. Leave empty if you use separate charge/discharge sensors below.
data_description.p_akku_invert: Enable if your sensor reports charging as positive.
data_description.soc_sensor: Unlocks the PV battery thresholds (Charges from / Discharges until) in the Wattpilot app. Works with any battery brand.
data_description.p_load_sensor: House consumption. Fronius reports it as negative; only used for autonomy and self-consumption figures.
data_description.p_load_invert: Enable if your consumption sensor is positive (most are).

battery_split.name: Separate charge/discharge sensors
battery_split.description: Use these instead of the signed battery sensor if your battery reports charge and discharge as two positive values.

data_description.p_akku_charge_sensor: Power going into the battery (positive values).
data_description.p_akku_discharge_sensor: Power coming out of the battery (positive values).

meter.title: Virtual smart meter
meter.description: Emulates a Fronius Smart Meter IP over Modbus TCP. After setup, add a Smart Meter IP on your Fronius inverter at this Home Assistant's IP address with the unit ID below.

data_description.name: Also used as the meter's serial number.
data_description.meter_role: Where the Fronius inverter uses this meter. For an AC-coupled battery choose External generator, and pick the same position on the Fronius.
data_description.modbus_port: Fronius uses 502. Several virtual meters can share a port.
data_description.modbus_address: Must be unique on this port. The virtual inverter's own grid meter uses 240 by default.

meter_power.title: Meter power
meter_power.description:
The power flowing through this meter. With a single signed sensor, positive means {positive} and negative means {negative}.

After setup, check the meter in the Fronius web interface or Solar.web. If the power flows the wrong way, enable Invert.

data_description.p_grid_sensor: Leave empty if you use separate inflow/outflow sensors below.
data_description.grid_phases: A single-phase device is reported on phase 1.

meter_split.name: Separate inflow/outflow sensors
meter_split.description: Two positive-only sensors instead of one signed sensor.

data_description.p_grid_import_sensor: Power flowing into the device: battery charging, consumption or grid import.
data_description.p_grid_export_sensor: Power flowing out of the device: battery discharging, generation or grid export.

error.port_in_use: This port is already in use by another program.
error.unit_id_in_use: Another virtual meter already uses this unit ID on this port.
error.invalid_hostname: Use letters, digits and hyphens only (no spaces), e.g. fronius-virtual.
error.name_in_use: Already used by another virtual inverter or meter.
error.sensor_required: Select a sensor, or use the separate sensors section.
error.sensor_conflict: Use either the single signed sensor or the separate sensors, not both.

init.description: Pick a section. Saving it reloads the integration.

load_balancing.title: Load balancing (per-phase sensors)
load_balancing.description: Optional, e.g. from a Fronius Smart Meter or Shelly 3EM. Without them, grid power is split evenly and currents are derived at 240 V. Power factor and reactive power sensors keep load balancing stable when real power is near zero. Phases B and C appear once the grid connection is set to three phase under Grid & solar.

modbus.title: Smart Meter IP (Modbus TCP)
modbus.description: Also serve the grid values as a Fronius Smart Meter IP, e.g. as the primary meter of a real Fronius inverter. For additional meters, such as an AC-coupled battery, add a Virtual smart meter instead.

data_description.modbus_enabled: Serve this inverter's grid power as a Smart Meter IP.
data_description.modbus_port: Fronius uses 502. Several virtual meters can share a port.
data_description.modbus_address: Must be unique on this port (default 240).
